title: Dark patterns in e-commerce: a dataset and its baseline evaluations
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'dark patterns,' which are defined as manipulative user interface designs that induce unintended actions. The abstract states that 'dark patterns have been raised as an issue of privacy and fairness.' The discussion includes regulatory actions by bodies like the California Legislature (CCPA), CNIL, OECD, and EDPB, all aimed at protecting users from the unethical manipulation inherent in dark patterns, especially concerning privacy and informed consent.
